instruction: I need to disable the background cone visualization in VLC as it distracts me when no media is playing. Can you turn off this feature in the settings?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone visualization in VLC (qt-bgcone setting). The evaluator checks if qt-bgcone is set to 0 (disabled) in the VLC configuration file. This is a similar UI customization task to the original, requiring navigation through VLC preferences.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_qt_bgcone metric function. Expected value: qt-bgcone=0 in vlcrc configuration file.
